title: From Everlasting to Everlasting

questions.question: Lord, you have been our dwelling place in all what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 90:1 (ESV): "Lord, you have been our dwelling place in all generations."

questions.question: Before the mountains were brought forth, or ever you had formed the earth and the world, from everlasting to everlasting you are what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 90:2 (ESV): "...from everlasting to everlasting you are God."

questions.question: You return man to dust and say, "Return, O children of what?"
For a thousand years in your sight are but as yesterday when it is past, or as a watch in the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 90:4 (ESV): "...or as a watch in the night."

questions.question: In the morning it flourishes and is renewed; in the evening it fades and does what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 90:6 (ESV): "in the evening it fades and withers."

questions.question: For we are brought to an end by your anger; by your wrath we are what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 90:7 (ESV): "...by your wrath we are dismayed."

questions.question: You have set our iniquities before you, our secret sins in the light of your what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 90:8 (ESV): "...our secret sins in the light of your presence."

questions.question: For all our days pass away under your wrath; we bring our years to an end like a what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 90:9 (ESV): "...we bring our years to an end like a sigh."

questions.question: The years of our life are seventy, or even by reason of strength how many?
questions.explanation: Psalm 90:10 (ESV): "The years of our life are seventy, or even by reason of strength eighty;"

questions.question: So teach us to number our days that we may get a heart of what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 90:12 (ESV): "So teach us to number our days that we may get a heart of wisdom."

questions.question: Return, O Lord! How long? Have pity on your what?
Satisfy us in the morning with your steadfast love, that we may rejoice and be glad when?
questions.explanation: Psalm 90:14 (ESV): "...that we may rejoice and be glad all our days."

questions.question: Make us glad for as many days as you have afflicted us, and for as many years as we have seen what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 90:15 (ESV): "...and for as many years as we have seen evil."

questions.question: Let your work be shown to your servants, and your glorious power to their what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 90:16 (ESV): "...and your glorious power to their children."

questions.question: Let the favor of the Lord our God be upon us, and establish the work of our what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 90:17 (ESV): "establish the work of our hands upon us; yes, establish the work of our hands!"

key_verse_text: So teach us to number our days that we may get a heart of wisdom.
